Resident of the Great Lakes region here. 🙋‍♀️ Lake Huron doesn't have ice shelves. It sits between 44 and 45 degrees N, which is too close to the equator for permanent ice shelves to form, even during the present Icehouse Earth phase.
Shelf ice has started forming along the south shore of Lake Michigan after temperatures dropped, encasing the coastline in a frigid barrier that obscures where the beach ends and the lake begins.
Shelf ice forms when water and winds wash ice onto the shore at places like Lake Michigan.
